context: Three guys at the family home. Sho plays with new toy; Riku and Ren join in.
purpose: small three-generation male family playful moment

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: リクお兄ちゃん、れんお兄ちゃん、一緒に遊ぼう！
lines.en: Riku-onii-chan, Ren-onii-chan — come play with us!
lines.style: Eager, high-pitched invitation from a six-year-old. Bright attack on each name. Simple, genuine delight in the request. Soft and open throughout — no performance, just real warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Quick, easy agreement. Slight lift on the question — genuinely curious what Sho wants to do. Warm and present without trying. A teenager being actually here with his younger brother.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Soft, slightly tentative request. Ren asking permission more than announcing arrival. Gentle tone, not pushing. Real kindness in the simplicity of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 皆で、楽しい！ありがとう、お兄ちゃんたち。
lines.en: Everyone together — that's fun! Thank you, big brothers.
lines.style: Quiet amazement and gratitude from a small child. Gentle breathiness on the thank you. Pure relief and joy that the ask worked. No irony, no second layer — just what he feels.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お兄ちゃんたちも、楽しい。ありがとうな。
lines.en: We're having fun too. Thanks for including us, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, genuine reply. Soft certainty — not effusive, just true. A teenager acknowledging what just happened. Tenderness underneath the simplicity. Slight trailing-off, like he means more than the words say.
